full_judgment:
6. Out of the defendants, only defendant No. 34 contested the suit by filing written statements contending that the suit was not maintainable, barred by limitation and there was no community of interest between the parties for partition of the suit property. The positive case of the defendant was that the CS recorded tenants voluntarily surrendered their rayoti right to the superior landlords from whom Bashanto Kumar took pattan and paid rent to the landlords. The plaintiff took settlement of 0.23 acre land from the suit jote from Bashanto Kumar and erected dwelling house therein and thereafter, SA Khatian No. 157 and RS Khatian No. 134 were prepared and finally published in his name. Bashanto Kumar transferred 0.59 acre land out of the suit property along with other land measuring total 2.305 acre by registered sale deed No. 7799 dated 9-5-1952 to Younus Sonar (defendant No. 34). While Younus Sonar was owning and possessing said 0.59 acre land from the suit jote separate SA Khatian No. 155 and RS Khatian No. 117 were prepared and finally published in his name. The plaintiff has no right, title to or interest in 0.59 acre land and, as such, the suit is liable to be dismissed. 

 12. Apart from adducing three oral witnesses the plaintiff produced CS Khatian No. 220 (Exhibit-1), the application of Pre-emption Case No. 19 of 1970 (Exhibit-2), the judgment and order passed in the pre-emption case (Exhibit-3), certified copy of RS Khatian Nos. 117, 133 and 134 (Exhibits-4 series) and SA Khatian Nos. 156 and 157 (Exhibits-5 series). On the other hand, defendant No. 34 adduced three oral witnesses and also produced Jamindary rent receipt (Exhibit-Ka), the rent receipt showing payment of rent by Emran Sonar to Bashanto Kumar (Exhibit-Kha series), rent receipts showing payment of rent by Ismail Sonar (Exhibit-Ga series), one pattani receipt (Exhibit-Gha), twelve rent receipts showing payment of rent to the Government (Exhibit-Uma series), the original sale deed No. 7799 dated 9-10-1952 (Exhibit-Cha), certified copy of SA Khatian No. 155 (Exhibit-Chha), certified copy of RS Khatian No. 117 (Exhibit-Ja), order passed in a proceeding under section 144 of the Code of Criminal Procedure and application filed therein (Exhibits-Jha and Neo).
